en.dr-ali-peiravi: 1-11 Suleiman ibn Ahmad ibn Ayoob al-Lakhmy narrated that Abdul Wahab ibn Kharajat quoted on the authority of Abu Kurayb, on the authority of Ali ibn Hafs al-Abasi, on the authority of Al-Hassan ibn al-Hussein al-Alavi, on the authority of his father Al-Hussein ibn Zayd, on the authority of Ja’far ibn Muhammad as-Sadiq (MGB), on the authority of his father Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir (MGB), on the authority of his father Ali ibn al-Hussein as-Sajjad (MGB), on the authority of Al-Hussein ibn Ali (MGB) , on the authority of Ali ibn Abi Talib (MGB) that God’s Prophet (MGB) said, “
I swear by Him in whose Hands is my soul that no two things have combined together better than knowledge and patience.”
